about: Guild Notices: untimed bounties on the board by the guild-house step. Card head GUILD NOTICE, one verb TAKE, the word 'untimed' printed on every card. Body at most three lines.
head: GUILD NOTICE

notices.title: THREE LAMPGLASSES, ANY KIND
notices.from: the Lantern-Keeper, by the Matron's hand
body: The breakwater lens is crazed and the house
will not buy what can be picked up.
Whole glass only. Cracked is no use to a lamp.
notices.done: Three glasses. Mise will see the beach road again.

notices.title: PINS OUT OF THE DYKES
notices.from: the caulkers of the black beach
body: Every peg in a dyke wall is a leak by winter.
Draw them once their heads go dark, never lit.
Bring the pins. Bronze holds a strake.
notices.done: Twelve pins. The dykes are tight and two boats are on the ramp.
